name: Nem nuong Cai Rang
summary: Nem nướng Cái Răng is lean pork grilled on skewers over charcoal, served with peanut sauce, herbs, pickles, and bánh hỏi. It is the lunch to eat back in town after the floating market.
origin: Cái Răng. Eat it in town at lunch after the market.
howToEat: Eat the pork with bánh hỏi, herbs, pickles, and the peanut sauce.
where: In town, after the morning at Cái Răng.
seoDescription: Charcoal pork skewers with peanut sauce, herbs, pickles, and bánh hỏi, eaten in town after the Cái Răng boats.
